newsitem.title: UK: Eurostar to resume 90 pct of services on Dec 4.
newsitem.headline: Eurostar to resume 90 pct of services on Dec 4.

text.p: Eurostar, which runs the express passenger trains through the Channel Tunnel to London, Paris and Brussels, confirmed late on Tuesday that it would restart 90 percent of its normal services on Wednesday.
A spokesman told Reuters that the operator would run 13 trains per day to Paris from December 4, one less than normal.
He added that seven trains per day would run to Brussels, rather than the normal eight.
"We can run 90 percent of our services from tomrrow," the spokesman said.
Eurotunnel Plc/SA earlier got the go-ahead to reopen the Channel tunnel railway to passenger services.

After a key safety committee meeting in London, the Inter- Governmental Commission (IGC) of French and British government representatives said the tunnel, which was closed after a fire in the tunnel two weeks ago, could now be reopened.
